fact: On 23-24 June 2026 the ECOWAS Commission held a workshop in Conakry on its programme to provide assistive devices to children with disabilities, where Guinea's Minister of Women, Family and Social Solidarity reaffirmed government commitment to expanding access to assistive technologies.
title: Guinea's Minister of Women, Family and Social Solidarity reaffirms commitment to disability inclusion as ECOWAS convenes regional workshop on assistive technologies for children with disabilities
